worldcombat.skill.mist.summary: Cloaks the body and nearby allies in a white mist; inside it no combatant's stat stages can be lowered. The mist follows the caster, and anyone who leaves its reach loses the cover; several mist sources are kept separately, so one ending does not remove another.
worldcombat.skill.mist.use.0: Block blanket drops to defence, attack or speed
worldcombat.skill.mist.use.1: Cover an ally that is winding up or setting up
worldcombat.skill.mist.use.2: Raise the mist before the foe starts weakening you
worldcombat.skill.mist.description.0: The mist covers the caster and allies within %2$s blocks for %1$s: while it holds, any stat-stage drop on anyone inside is caught by the mist and never takes effect.
worldcombat.skill.mist.description.1: It follows the caster's movement; the current cast range is %1$s blocks. Allies who leave the radius stop being renewed by this source and lose this cover once its short renewal runs out; several sources settle separately, so one ending does not remove another. It only stops drops, not damage or control.
worldcombat.skill.mist.description.2: Breathing the mist takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. See the veil note for the dense/thin trade-off.
worldcombat.skill.mist.veil.0: Dense: radius x1.25, duration x1.2, at +3 ticks wind-up and x1.15 cooldown — wide and long.
worldcombat.skill.mist.veil.1: Thin: radius x0.75, duration x0.75, in exchange for -2 ticks wind-up and x0.8 cooldown — quick to raise and refresh.
worldcombat.skill.mist.timing: Cast on yourself: after %1$s of preparation it spends %3$s PP; the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %4$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.mist.preference.veil.h: Dense: radius x1.25, duration x1.2, +3 ticks wind-up, x1.15 cooldown — good to hold a position and cover several allies. Thin: radius x0.75, duration x0.75, -2 ticks wind-up, x0.8 cooldown — good to keep the whole team covered on the move.
worldcombat.skill.mist.preference.ai.max: The partner only considers raising the mist while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee pressure, larger prepares from farther away.
worldcombat.skill.mist.preference.ai.ope: Under pressure: only while a foe is attacking the partner or its owner, or the partner was just hurt. Anytime: raise the mist on any threat.
worldcombat.skill.mist.preference.ai.lea: When on, the partner will also leave its post to raise the mist.
